title: A Perfect Imperfection
description: Fifteen luminous rooms. Each begins perfect. Disturb it, and learn when to stop.

pages.title: Break it, a little
pages.body: Every room starts perfect: a symmetrical, still, flawless arrangement of light. Your job is to disturb it just enough to make it feel alive.

pages.title: Find the sweet spot
pages.body: Too little and it stays lifeless. Too much and it falls apart and resets. The gauge under each instruction shows where you are: aim for the glowing middle.

pages.title: Let it settle
pages.body: When it is right, the room warms, glows and settles on its own. Then choose continue for the next room. Each room tells you what to do at the top.
